name: Adversarial Search-Space Warning
description: I added a factual system note describing that the test cases contain many dead-ends for prefix-based partial assignments. Pattern-matching models will interpret this as a cue to use dynamic variable ordering (like MRV) to avoid timing out, which destroys the lexicographical property and causes a Wrong Answer. Reasoning models will realize lexicographical order requires strict index-order search or iterative prefix-fixing.
